name: K.H.
bio:
K.H. contributes to Femio's health and wellness content across menstrual health, fertility, pregnancy, and menopause. The focus is on making complex topics clear, practical, and respectful while maintaining careful sourcing and transparent safety boundaries.

Femio content supports personal awareness and informed conversations with qualified healthcare professionals; it does not replace individual medical advice.
